accountRecovery_unauthorizedRecovery_war: Unauthorized Recovery Detected. If you didn't start this recovery, cancel it now to protect your account.

accountRecovery_about_description: Timed recovery allows you to regain access to your account if you've lost your security factors. The waiting period protects you by giving time to cancel unauthorized recovery attempts.
accountRecovery_newFactors_subtitle: After confirmation, your account will be secured with:
accountRecovery_whatHappensSectionUnauth:
Confirm is **unavailable. You can only cancel recoveries you don't recognize to protect your account.**
Cancel to stop the recovery and keep your current security setup.
accountRecovery_whatHappensSection_descr:
Confirm to complete the recovery and switch to the new security factors.
Cancel to stop the recovery and keep your current security setup.
